title: DeLonge–Podesta disclosure meeting with Robert Weiss

tellings.quote: this meeting where all these guys are at this meeting in in uh 2016 in January

plain: In January 2016, the political adviser John Podesta, the rock musician Tom DeLonge and a man named Robert Weiss are said to have met in Washington to talk about making public what the government knows about UFOs. The researcher Grant Cameron tells Michels about "this meeting where all these guys are at", drawing on the Podesta emails, the messages from Podesta's account that WikiLeaks published in 2016. If it happened as he describes, it would mean disclosure was being discussed with people close to the White House.
